summary: performance lens over selection-ui (17 product path(s), 23ed18e..00347bf, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 0 non-blocking. The UI and API additions otherwise follow the supplied contracts, and the diff contains no compatibility wrapper or retained legacy symbol. However, the backend derives bucket-row amounts from GL-level result rows and repeats those aggregates for every matching cost-centre triple, so the core reviewable bucket can display materially incorrect and duplicated values.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Do not assign GL-level totals to every bucket triple (backend/src/mis/mis-selection.service.ts:164): `amounts` is keyed only by `gl_code`, while `configured` can contain multiple cost-centre triples for the same GL.
